value.answer: This sounds like an ordinary cold - runny nose and mild cough without fever are common in preschoolers and usually clear up on their own in a week or so. Offer fluids, rest, and saline drops if the nose is stuffy. Watch for fever developing, fast or laboured breathing, ear pain, or symptoms lasting over 10-14 days without improving.
value.triage: Call 811 if symptoms drag on past 10-14 days, worsen, or a new fever/ear pain shows up. Go to the ER or call 911 now if breathing becomes fast, laboured, ribs pull in, lips look bluish/dusky, or your child becomes very drowsy or hard to wake.
